label: The CEC flow
subgoals: Match inputs, outputs and registers between the designs
Cut the registers into pseudo-inputs and pseudo-outputs
Build one miter per output cone and solve it

label: Simplify before you solve
subgoals: Merge both designs with structural hashing
Use random simulation to separate non-equivalent nodes
Prove the remaining candidates bottom-up with SAT and merge them

label: Engines and results
subgoals: Choose BDDs for small control cones and SAT for large netlists
Run the check with a tool such as ABC's cec
Classify each result as proof, real difference, environment issue or timeout
